egress.terms: downloads 'unlimited and unthrottled' — this is the most generous free egress found in the niche, it just cannot hold data

tooling: documented 33-endpoint REST API (init -> presigned PUT -> confirm), presigned URLs point at r2.cloudflarestorage.com; CLI + desktop app + ShareX; no rclone
chaining: the upload quota is per visitor token AND per IP, so 100 GB/24h x N tokens (up to the 500 GB/IP ceiling) x N IPs — a throughput engine rather than a store; pairs well as the write side in front of a permanent store
limits_note: 25 GB/file (100 GB paid); 100 GB/24h per visitor token, 500 GB/24h per IP; 50 files/24h anonymous; expiry 3 days default, 7 max; 60-500 req/min per endpoint
